dimension_basis: Garment-local prototype parameters authored for this isolated study, not anatomical dimensions or calibration values.
authoring_instruction: Retain the original mint/ivory cape identity: rounded scalloped collar, open front, layered hems, a small padded connected bow, restrained gold bindings and two pairs of leaf relief. Build new authored closed material solids with actual neck and front passages; do not infer a body or original backside.

generic_audit_reuse.scope: Only generic actual-triangle topology, face normal and strict point-overlap helpers; prior garment recipe is excluded.

back_and_interior: New authored garment design, not a recovered original rear or anatomical volume.
fastening: Fixed bow, not an operable clasp or closure mechanism.
passage_scope: Finite authored segments tested against actual triangles of every part; not continuous collision safety.
attachment_scope: Strict points inside actual material triangles of both attached parts, three probe directions and positive surface clearance. Finite witness scope; no load/friction guarantee.

cloth_normal_construction.same_unit_visual_repair: Actual Chrome showed broad flat panels. Share normals within continuous cloth surfaces; preserve thickness/front/rim creases.
cloth_normal_construction.comparison_scope: Normal smoothing step only. A later same-unit binding repair intentionally extends five gold solids; main cloth triangles remain unchanged.

binding_visual_repair.observed_issue: Actual exported front and bottom PNGs showed jagged alternating colors at coplanar exposed front/rim faces.
binding_visual_repair.method: Extend five gold binding solids beyond target rim domains; fully enclose target cut faces in actual gold volume. Front endcaps are staggered past hem bindings.
binding_visual_repair.finite_enclosure_evidence: Actual target rim triangle centroids must be strictly inside the intended gold solid with positive clearance; independent ray audit repeats these finite points.

binding_endpoint_finish_repair.observed_issue: Actual Chrome front view showed two unintended gold tips above cream neckline after the rim wrap repair.
binding_endpoint_finish_repair.method: Front binding starts at garment t=.012 below neckline; its top has outer offset .015 and thickness .055, wholly inside an extended cream collar lap. Smoothstep profile reaches previous enclosing dimensions by t=.18.
binding_endpoint_finish_repair.finite_verification: Exact front strip top-cap triangle centroids are strictly inside actual cream collar material, independently rechecked alongside remaining rim coverage.
